parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the main outlet of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, through which water flows.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of water from the faucet body to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move independently, though it may swivel in some designs.

parts.name: Screw (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A small stainless steel screw used to secure internal or external parts of the faucet assembly.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the faucet components together, ensuring structural stability and leak prevention.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary once tightened and does not move during normal faucet operation.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle or lever of the faucet, made of durable ABS plastic for easy grip and control.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by adjusting the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or lifts to open and close the water flow, allowing smooth manual operation.
